basicsGuide.title: Prerequisite: Absolute Basics
basicsGuide.body: Theory Academy opens with combinatorics. If you still want to confirm hand rankings, position names, betting actions and terminology, spend a few minutes on the Strategy Academy basics wizard first — it does not count toward theory progress, but it makes every chapter after T1 easier.

drill.title: Do the Math
drill.subtitle: Apply the formula you just read. It is not scored, and you can reroll a problem and try again
drill.disclaimer: Not counted toward progress or rating
drill.incorrect: Outside the tolerance — run the formula in the hint once more

template.alpha: Pot {{pot}} bb, villain bets {{bet}} bb. What fold frequency (in %) must villain have for your bluff to break even?
template.mdf: Pot {{pot}} bb, villain bets {{bet}} bb. To stop villain bluffing with any two cards, what minimum frequency (in %) must you continue?
template.requiredEquity: Pot {{pot}} bb, villain bets {{bet}} bb. What equity (in %) do you need to call?
template.kelly: A spot wins {{winrate}}% of the time and pays {{odds}} times your risked amount when it hits. What share of your bankroll (in %) does full Kelly recommend?
template.halfKelly: Win rate {{winrate}}%, net odds {{odds}}x. What share of your bankroll (in %) does half Kelly suggest?
template.requiredHands: You win {{edge}} bb/100 with a standard deviation of {{sd}} bb/100 at z = {{z}}. Roughly how many hands separate that edge from noise?
template.riskOfRuin: Win rate {{winrate}} bb/100, std deviation {{sd}} bb/100, bankroll {{buyins}} buy-ins of 100 bb. Under the diffusion approximation, what is the risk of ruin (in %)?
template.multiwayBluffFold: Pot {{pot}} bb and you bet {{bet}} bb. If each of the {{defenders}} players still to act folds at exactly the break-even rate, what is the all-fold probability (in %)?
template.outsEquity: You have {{outs}} outs. With {{streets}} card(s) still to come, what is the exact hit probability (in %)? Use the exact formula, not the ×2/×4 rule.
template.pairCombos: Villain's range consists of {{tiers}} distinct pocket-pair ranks, and the board shows {{boardHits}} of those ranks (one card each). How many combos is the range?
template.af: A player's hand log records {{bets}} bets, {{raises}} raises and {{calls}} calls. What is his aggression factor?
template.vpip: This player voluntarily put money in the pot {{hands}} times out of {{total}} hands. What is his VPIP (in %)?

hint.mdf: MDF = P / (P + b), complementary to alpha
hint.requiredEquity: required equity = amount to call / pot after the call = b / (P + 2b)
hint.halfKelly: half Kelly = f* / 2, with f* = (b*p - q) / b
hint.requiredHands: n = (z * sigma / mu)^2; sigma = std dev (bb/100) / 10, mu = winrate (bb/100) / 100
hint.multiwayBluffFold: all-fold rate = product of the individual fold rates = alpha raised to the number of defenders
hint.pairCombos: a rank not seen on the board has 6 combos (C(4,2)); once one card of that rank is visible it has 3 (C(3,2))
hint.vpip: VPIP = voluntarily invested hands ÷ total hands × 100
